Parser fixtures, redistributed for regression tests.

tile_root.osgb, tile_l17.osgb, metadata.xml
  From Sogrey/Cesium-start-Example (MIT), SampleData/models/dayanta_osgb.
  ContextCapture-style OSGB, OpenSceneGraph SO version 91.

blockx_l19.osgb, blockx_meta.xml
  From XEMPZ/GeoRefine sample_data (OSGB SO version 131, binary brackets, EPSG:4547).

These files are not the user's 来安 survey. They only check that the reader
reaches the end of a real file and returns finite local coordinates.
